    export type AnswerPayload = {
        kind: "ask_user";
        answers: Record<string, string>;
        annotations?: Record<string, AskUserAnnotation>;
        typed?: boolean;
    } | {
        kind: "ask_user_list";
        answers: Record<string, string>;
        notes?: Record<string, string>;
    } | {
        kind: "ask_user_rank";
        order: string[];
        unchanged: boolean;
    } | {
        kind: "ask_user_form";
        answers: AskUserFormAnswers;
        visibleNodes: string[];
    };

    export interface RecordingStore {
        budget(): Promise<RecordingBudget>;
        start(options?: Omit<StartLocalCaptureOptions, "sink">): Promise<LocalCapture>;
        sink(): LocalCaptureSink;
        stop(reason: LocalCaptureStopReason): Promise<void>;
        active(): Pick<Recording, "partition" | "id"> | null;
        list(partition: PartitionId): Promise<Recording[]>;
        get(partition: PartitionId, id: string): Promise<Recording | undefined>;
        recover(partition: PartitionId): Promise<RecordingRecovery>;
        dismissRemoved(partition: PartitionId): Promise<void>;
        playback(partition: PartitionId, id: string): Promise<{
            url: string;
            revoke(): void;
        }>;
        discard(partition: PartitionId, id: string): Promise<void>;
        saveTranscript(partition: PartitionId, id: string, text: string): Promise<void>;
        accept(partition: PartitionId, id: string, draftId: string, sessionId: string | null, expectedTranscript?: string): Promise<void>;
        assign(id: string): Promise<void>;
        busy(): boolean;
        subscribe(listener: () => void): () => void;
        onEvent(listener: (event: RecordingEvent) => void): () => void;
        dispose(): void;
    }

    export function createBrainApi(getBase: () => string, request?: (url: string, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>): {
        activityDigest: (clientId?: string) => Promise<{
            actions?: ActionDigestState;
            digest: ActivityDigest | null;
            dismissedAt: number;
        }>;
        activityDigestDismiss: (clientId?: string, through?: number) => Promise<{
            ok: true;
        }>;
        activityInbox: () => Promise<{
            intents: ActivityIntent[];
        }>;
        activityInboxAck: (id: number) => Promise<{
            ok: true;
        }>;
        activityInboxAckAll: () => Promise<{
            acknowledged: number;
        }>;
        activityRollups: (days?: number) => Promise<ActivityRollups>;
        activityRun: (runId: string, opts?: {
            includePayloads?: boolean;
        }) => Promise<ActivityRunDetail>;
        activityRuns: (opts?: {
            before?: number;
            job?: string;
            limit?: number;
            origin?: ActivitySpanOrigin;
            session?: string;
            status?: string;
        }) => Promise<{
            history: ActivityRunSummary[];
            live: ActivityRunSummary[];
        }>;
        activityStats: (days?: number) => Promise<ActivityRuntimeStats>;
        authMethods: () => Promise<{
            passkey: boolean;
            password: boolean;
        }>;
        brainAdd: (content: string, opts?: {
            tags?: string[];
            title?: string;
            type?: string;
        }) => Promise<{
            indexError?: string;
            indexed?: boolean;
            path?: string;
            success: boolean;
        }>;
        brainBriefing: () => Promise<{
            content: string;
        }>;
        brainIndex: () => Promise<{
            success: boolean;
        }>;
        brainSearch: (q: string, opts?: {
            limit?: number;
            mode?: "fts" | "hybrid" | "vector";
            signal?: AbortSignal;
            tag?: string;
            type?: string;
        }) => Promise<BrainSearchResponse>;
        brainStats: () => Promise<CorpusStats>;
        brainStatsHistory: () => Promise<CorpusStatsHistory>;
        brainSync: () => Promise<{
            message: string;
            success: boolean;
        }>;
        fileResolve: (path: string) => Promise<{
            ancestors: string[];
            exists: boolean;
            path: string;
            type?: "dir" | "file";
        }>;
        geoCoastline: (bbox: [number, number, number, number], opts?: {
            signal?: AbortSignal;
            width?: number;
        }) => Promise<CoastlineGeometry>;
        health: () => Promise<{
            status: string;
            timestamp: string;
            uptime: number;
        }>;
        login: (password: string) => Promise<{
            ok: true;
        }>;
        logout: () => Promise<{
            ok: true;
        }>;
        models: () => Promise<ModelCatalogResponse>;
        moduleAction: (name: string, id: string) => Promise<unknown>;
        moduleMigrationApply: (name: string, revision: string) => Promise<ModuleSettingsSnapshot>;
        moduleMigrationPreview: (name: string) => Promise<ModuleSettingsMigrationPreview>;
        moduleSettings: (name: string) => Promise<ModuleSettingsSnapshot>;
        moduleSettingsPreview: (name: string, values: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<ModuleSettingsSnapshot>;
        moduleSettingsSave: (name: string, values: Record<string, unknown>, revision: string) => Promise<ModuleSettingsSnapshot>;
        moduleState: (name: string, state: "active" | "dormant") => Promise<{
            changed: boolean;
            context: {
                entered: string[];
                left: string[];
            };
            module: string;
            state: "active" | "dormant";
        }>;
        modulesList: () => Promise<{
            available: unknown[];
            enabled: ConfiguredModule[];
        }>;
        passkeyDelete: (id: string) => Promise<{
            ok: true;
        }>;
        passkeyList: () => Promise<{
            credentials: PasskeySummary[];
        }>;
        passkeyLoginOptions: () => Promise<PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptionsJSON>;
        passkeyLoginVerify: (response: AuthenticationResponseJSON) => Promise<{
            ok: true;
        }>;
        passkeyRegisterOptions: () => Promise<PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptionsJSON>;
        passkeyRegisterVerify: (response: RegistrationResponseJSON, label?: string) => Promise<{
            credential: PasskeySummary | null;
            ok: true;
        }>;
        passkeyRename: (id: string, label: string) => Promise<{
            ok: true;
        }>;
        piAuthCancel: (id: string) => Promise<{
            ok: boolean;
        }>;
        piAuthFlow: (id: string) => Promise<{
            flow: PiLoginFlow;
        }>;
        piAuthLogout: (providerId: string) => Promise<{
            ok: boolean;
        }>;
        piAuthProviders: () => Promise<{
            providers: PiAuthProviderStatus[];
        }>;
        piAuthStart: (providerId: string) => Promise<{
            flow: PiLoginFlow;
        }>;
        pricingState: () => Promise<PricingState>;
        principalMint: (label: string, ttlDays: number) => Promise<MintedAgent>;
        principalRevoke: (id: string) => Promise<{
            ok: true;
        }>;
        principals: () => Promise<{
            principals: PrincipalSummary[];
        }>;
        providers: () => Promise<{
            backends?: Record<string, BackendInfo>;
            providers: ProviderInfo[];
            unavailable?: UnavailableProfileInfo[];
        }>;
        pushPublicKey: () => Promise<{
            publicKey: string;
        }>;
        pushSubscribe: (subscription: unknown, label?: string, timeZone?: string) => Promise<{
            ok: true;
        }>;
        pushUnsubscribe: (endpoint: string) => Promise<{
            removed: boolean;
        }>;
        pushZone: (timeZone: string, endpoint?: string, clientId?: string) => Promise<{
            ok: true;
            timeZone: null | string;
        }>;
        refreshModels: () => Promise<ModelCatalogResponse>;
        sessionRecovery: (sessionId: string, opts?: {
            signal?: AbortSignal;
        }) => Promise<SessionRecoveryResult>;
        sessions: () => Promise<{
            sessions: Array<{
                backendId?: string;
                createdAt: number;
                handoffFrom?: {
                    afterTurns?: number;
                    backendId?: string;
                    sessionId: string;
                    title: null | string;
                };
                id: string;
                label?: string;
                lastActiveAt: number;
                numTurns: number;
                title: null | string;
                totalCostUsd: number;
            }>;
            unavailableBackends?: string[];
        }>;
        setBillingOverrides: (billing: Record<string, BillingMode>) => Promise<ModelCatalogResponse>;
        setCustomModels: (models: string[]) => Promise<ModelCatalogResponse>;
        setDefaultModel: (defaultId: null | string) => Promise<ModelCatalogResponse>;
        setHiddenModels: (hidden: string[]) => Promise<ModelCatalogResponse>;
        setThinkingOverrides: (thinking: Record<string, ThinkingLevel>) => Promise<ModelCatalogResponse>;
        skillCreate: (name: string, content: string) => Promise<{
            skill: SkillEntry;
            warning?: string;
        }>;
        skillGet: (name: string) => Promise<SkillDetail>;
        skillInstallGitHub: (source: string, overwrite: boolean, ref?: string) => Promise<{
            outcomes: SkillInstallOutcome[];
            warning?: string;
        }>;
        skillInstallZip: (file: File, overwrite: boolean) => Promise<{
            outcomes: SkillInstallOutcome[];
            warning?: string;
        }>;
        skillRemove: (name: string) => Promise<{
            ok: boolean;
            warning?: string;
        }>;
        skillSetEnabled: (name: string, enabled: boolean) => Promise<{
            skill: SkillEntry;
            warning?: string;
        }>;
        skillUpdate: (name: string, content: string) => Promise<{
            skill: SkillEntry;
            warning?: string;
        }>;
        skillsList: () => Promise<{
            skills: SkillEntry[];
        }>;
        status: () => Promise<{
            activeSession: boolean;
            cronJobs: Array<{
                lastRunAt: null | number;
                lastStatus: null | string;
                name: string;
            }>;
            healthy: boolean;
            software?: {
                release: string;
                sourceCommit: string;
            };
            uptime: number;
            version?: string;
        }>;
        toolPermissionRevoke: (tool: string) => Promise<{
            tools: string[];
        }>;
        toolPermissions: () => Promise<{
            tools: string[];
        }>;
        voiceKeyterms: () => Promise<VoiceKeytermsResponse>;
        voiceOverrides: (signal?: AbortSignal) => Promise<{
            overrides: PronunciationOverride[];
        }>;
        voiceSession: (signal?: AbortSignal) => Promise<VoiceSessionResponse>;
        voiceToken: () => Promise<VoiceTokenResponse>;
        vpnCheck: () => Promise<{
            vpn: boolean;
        }>;
        webSearchConfig: () => Promise<WebSearchConfig>;
        webSearchUpdate: (update: {
            apiKeys?: Record<string, null | string>;
            clearOverride?: boolean;
            enabled?: Record<string, boolean>;
        }) => Promise<WebSearchConfig>;
    };

    export function createWebSocketClient(root: BrainUiServices): {
        answers: {
            cancel: (requestId: string) => Promise<void>;
            connected: () => void;
            disconnected: () => void;
            dismissed: (requestId: string) => void;
            dispose(): void;

            held: () => {
                owned: boolean;
                payload: import("./lib/answer-delivery/types.js").AnswerPayload;
                principalKey: string;
                requestId: string;
                sent: boolean;
                sessionId: null | string;
                submissionId: string;
                submittedAt: number;
                turnId: null | string;
                v: 1;
            }[];
            logout: () => Promise<void>;
            receipt: (frame: import("@schlessera/brain-ui-sdk").ServerAskAnswerReceipt) => void;
            retry: (requestId: string) => Promise<void>;
            start: () => Promise<void>;
            submit: (input: import("./lib/answer-delivery/manager.js").SubmitAnswer) => Promise<"admitted" | "ignored" | "refused">;
        };
        checkRetryDelivery: (sessionId: string) => boolean;
        connect: () => () => void;
        dispose(): void;
        drafts: {
            check: (requestId: string) => Promise<void>;
            edit: (requestId: string) => void;
            resend: (requestId: string) => boolean;
        };
        flushChatDeltas: () => void;
        handleServerMessage: (msg: ServerMessage) => void;
        reconnectNow: () => void;
        retryTurn: (failedTurnId: string) => "pending" | "refused" | "sent";
        send: (msg: ClientMessage) => boolean;
    };

        }>;
        skillRemove: (name: string) => Promise<{
            ok: boolean;
            warning?: string;
        }>;
        skillSetEnabled: (name: string, enabled: boolean) => Promise<{
            skill: import("./lib/api-client.js").SkillEntry;
            warning?: string;
        }>;
        skillUpdate: (name: string, content: string) => Promise<{
            skill: import("./lib/api-client.js").SkillEntry;
            warning?: string;
        }>;
        skillsList: () => Promise<{
            skills: import("./lib/api-client.js").SkillEntry[];
        }>;
        status: () => Promise<{
            activeSession: boolean;
            cronJobs: Array<{
                lastRunAt: null | number;
                lastStatus: null | string;
                name: string;
            }>;
            healthy: boolean;
            software?: {
                release: string;
                sourceCommit: string;
            };
            uptime: number;
            version?: string;
        }>;
        toolPermissionRevoke: (tool: string) => Promise<{
            tools: string[];
        }>;
        toolPermissions: () => Promise<{
            tools: string[];
        }>;
        voiceKeyterms: () => Promise<import("@schlessera/brain-ui-sdk").VoiceKeytermsResponse>;
        voiceOverrides: (signal?: AbortSignal) => Promise<{
            overrides: import("@schlessera/brain-ui-sdk").PronunciationOverride[];
        }>;
        voiceSession: (signal?: AbortSignal) => Promise<import("@schlessera/brain-ui-sdk").VoiceSessionResponse>;
        voiceToken: () => Promise<import("@schlessera/brain-ui-sdk").VoiceTokenResponse>;
        vpnCheck: () => Promise<{
            vpn: boolean;
        }>;
        webSearchConfig: () => Promise<import("./lib/api-client.js").WebSearchConfig>;
        webSearchUpdate: (update: {
            apiKeys?: Record<string, null | string>;
            clearOverride?: boolean;
            enabled?: Record<string, boolean>;
        }) => Promise<import("./lib/api-client.js").WebSearchConfig>;
    };
